hero.title: Welcome to
hero.imageAlt: Welcome photo of Les Jardins de Wesserling
hero.firstParagraph: Since 2000, the Les Jardins de Wesserling association has been working to transform the Parc de Wesserling into a vibrant, creative and community-focused place in the heart of the Vosges Mountains.
hero.secondParagraph: Through the kitchen gardens, events and educational spaces, the association promotes and enhances this heritage site while supporting social and professional inclusion and strengthening local solidarity.
hero.thirdParagraph: Today, around twenty people taking part in work integration programmes, supported by a dedicated team and many volunteers, contribute each year to the life and development of the gardens.
hero.fourthParagraph: Above all, Les Jardins de Wesserling is a place of sharing, creativity and learning, open to anyone who wishes to get involved or simply discover the site.
hero.fifthParagraph: A warm welcome to everyone who would like to join us.
hero.sixthParagraph: On behalf of the Board of Directors

garden.intro: The Wesserling kitchen garden introduces visitors to environmentally friendly gardening while offering a unique and relaxing stroll.

centralPath.imageAlt: Photo of the kitchen garden at Les Jardins de Wesserling
centralPath.description: The central pathway linking the former ponds forms the backbone of the kitchen garden. It creates a connection between horticulture and Wesserling’s industrial heritage. The arrangement of vegetables, flowers and herbs recreates textile patterns once designed in the former factory. Each year, a new composition is presented in connection with the theme of the Festival of Mixed Gardens.

pedagogy.imageAlt: Photo of the educational garden at Les Jardins de Wesserling
pedagogy.description: On either side of this axis extend the four sections of the educational kitchen garden. Their plots demonstrate gardening methods that work alongside natural processes: crop rotation, beneficial plant associations, the use of helpful insects and wildlife, soil and water management, and more. A pathway through a hedge reveals habitats for beneficial species useful to gardeners. Educational panels and games introduce visitors to the secrets of gardening.

orchard.imageAlt: Photo of the orchard at Les Jardins de Wesserling
orchard.description: A heritage quince orchard, a terrace of berries and aromatic plants complete this abundant garden, whose produce is sold or transformed at the Resto du Potager.

accessibility.imageAlt: Photo of a resting area at Les Jardins de Wesserling
accessibility.description: To ensure accessibility for everyone, including people with reduced mobility, numerous resting areas immersed in the vegetation are located throughout the kitchen garden pathways.

garden.membership: By becoming a member of the association or making a donation, you benefit from a 66% tax reduction, as the association is recognised as serving the public interest. Your support helps fund employment initiatives.

meta.title: The Kitchen Garden Restaurant — Les Jardins de Wesserling
meta.description: Discover the Kitchen Garden Restaurant, a light and seasonal restaurant located in the heart of Les Jardins de Wesserling.

atmosphere.imageAlt: Photo of the Kitchen Garden Restaurant at Les Jardins de Wesserling
atmosphere.firstParagraph: The Kitchen Garden Restaurant offers an original setting surrounded by flowers, vegetables and aromatic plants, within a décor inspired by fabrics inherited from the former Wesserling Textile Printing Factory. It is a social restaurant where service is provided by people taking part in work integration programmes.

solidarity.imageAlt: Photo of the social restaurant at Les Jardins de Wesserling
solidarity.firstParagraph: Having lunch at the Kitchen Garden Restaurant means supporting people seeking employment, as well as farmers from the surrounding mountain area, since part of the restaurant’s produce comes from their farms. More broadly, it also contributes to promoting Wesserling’s remarkable industrial heritage.

menu.imageAlt: Photo of the menu at the Kitchen Garden Restaurant
menu.firstParagraph: The menus reflect all the flavours of the kitchen garden: assorted fresh vegetable platters, vegetable tarts, seasonal fruit melba desserts, soups, syrups, and more. These are complemented by products from nearby mountain farms, including charcuterie and cheese platters.

produce.imageAlt: Photo of the fresh produce at the Kitchen Garden Restaurant
produce.firstParagraph: The vegetables, berries and herbs grown in the gardens are sold fresh at the Kitchen Garden Restaurant or transformed into jams.

meta.title: Festive Events — Les Jardins de Wesserling
meta.description: Discover the festive events organised by Les Jardins de Wesserling: the Festival of Mixed Gardens, the Nature Festival, and much more.

festive.title: Festive Events
festive.intro: Numerous festive events bring Wesserling’s industrial heritage to life throughout the year (link to the Parc website). Refreshments and light catering are provided by the work integration programme of the Les Jardins de Wesserling association: tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, sweet crêpes (and ice creams depending on the season), drinks including garden syrups. The Les Jardins de Wesserling association organises three events: the Garden Swap, the Music Festival and Cocktail Evenings. The association also provides light catering during events organised within the Parc de Wesserling, such as Pâques en Folie, Heritage Day, the Barefoot Trail Festival, the Night-Time Fairies, the Autumn Festival and Christmas in the Garden.

easter.imageAlt: Pâques en Folie at Les Jardins de Wesserling
easter.title: Pâques en Folie
easter.subtitle: During the week around Easter. From 12pm to 5pm. In the courtyard of the Wesserling Farm. Paid entry.
easter.firstParagraph: Egg hunt. Fun and creative workshops.
easter.secondParagraph: Refreshments, tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, Easter Bunny afternoon treats.
easter.thirdParagraph: Thousands of wooden eggs are hidden throughout the Rural Park. Participants search for these treasures by solving riddles and following clues. The wooden eggs are then exchanged for real chocolate eggs.

troc.imageAlt: Troc’Jardin at Les Jardins de Wesserling
troc.title: Troc’Jardin
troc.subtitle: The last Sunday of April from 10am to 6pm. In the courtyard of the Wesserling Farm. Free entry.
troc.firstParagraph: Swap area. Fun workshops. Advice stands. Vegetable sales stand.
troc.secondParagraph: Refreshments, tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes.
troc.thirdParagraph: This is a special moment for amateur gardeners to exchange seedlings, tools and advice. Participants can drop off their items from 10am onwards. They are “paid” in the event’s special currency: radish coins, which can then be used to obtain plants and items of their choice. Radish coins can also be earned by taking part in games, buying a tarte flambée or purchasing an association membership card.

festival.imageAlt: Festival des Jardins Métissés at Les Jardins de Wesserling
festival.title: Festival des Jardins Métissés
festival.subtitle: From June to October. From 10am to 6.30pm.
festival.firstParagraph: Refreshments, tarts, salads, charcuterie or cheese platters, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, ice creams.
festival.secondParagraph: The eco-museum of the Parc de Wesserling opens from May onwards. However, the Festival des Jardins Métissés begins in June. Each year, its temporary gardens built around a new theme transport visitors into poetic, artistic, playful and exotic worlds... perfect for wonderful family days out!

music.imageAlt: Fête de la Musique at Les Jardins de Wesserling
music.title: Fête de la Musique
music.subtitle: The Friday closest to 21 June. From 6pm to 11pm. In the courtyard of the Wesserling Farm. Free entry.
music.firstParagraph: Music throughout the evening. Free visit of the gardens and the Festival des Jardins Métissés.
music.secondParagraph: Refreshments, tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, ice creams.
music.thirdParagraph: Music lovers can discover a variety of musical styles while seated beneath the farm shelters or on the slopes of the Rural Park. The Fête de la Musique at Wesserling takes place within the remarkable setting of Wesserling’s industrial heritage.

cocktail.imageAlt: Soirées cocktails at Les Jardins de Wesserling
cocktail.title: Soirées cocktails
cocktail.subtitle: Three Fridays in July. From 6pm to 10pm. In the Wesserling kitchen gardens. Paid entry through the gardens. One cocktail included with the entrance ticket.
cocktail.firstParagraph: Cocktails with or without alcohol, refreshments, tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, ice creams.
cocktail.thirdParagraph: A moment of relaxation and conviviality in a garden that takes on a different appearance in the setting sun. A time to appreciate art in the garden in all its forms: musical, graphic, sculptural, choreographic and more.

nocturnes.imageAlt: Féeries Nocturnes at Les Jardins de Wesserling
nocturnes.title: Féeries Nocturnes

subtitle.text: Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays throughout August and during the week of 15 August. From 6.30pm to 11.30pm. Paid entry through the gardens.
subtitle.link: More information on the Parc de Wesserling website

nocturnes.firstParagraph: Large-scale game. Storytelling walks. Fire show.
nocturnes.secondParagraph: Refreshments, tarte flambée, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, ice creams.
nocturnes.thirdParagraph: As night falls, the gardens light up and everything becomes magical. The Féeries Nocturnes are an unforgettable experience for families and friends alike.

automne.imageAlt: Fête d'Automne at Les Jardins de Wesserling
automne.title: Fête d'Automne
automne.subtitle: Sunday in mid-October. From 10am to 6.30pm. Paid entry through the Manufacturers’ Château.
automne.firstParagraph: Gardening advice. Apple juice pressing. Creative workshops. Vegetable sales stand.
automne.secondParagraph: Refreshments, tarte flambée, soup bar, plain or gratinated pretzels, crêpes, ice creams.
automne.thirdParagraph: Gardens glowing with autumn colours, abundant vegetable harvests... This is the final event before the end of the Festival of Mixed Gardens. Gardeners share their advice, visitors can watch apple juice being pressed and taste this seasonal product. A well-stocked soup bar highlights freshly harvested vegetables. Everything is designed to delight both the eyes and the taste buds.

christmas.imageAlt: Noël au jardin at Les Jardins de Wesserling
christmas.title: Noël au jardin

subtitle.text: Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays throughout December and during the week between Christmas and New Year. From 5pm to 11pm. Paid entry through the Manufacturers’ Château. Mulled wine or hot apple juice included with the entrance ticket.
subtitle.link: More information on the Parc de Wesserling website

christmas.firstParagraph: Theatrical walk through the illuminated gardens.
christmas.secondParagraph: Refreshments, mulled wine, hot apple juice, hot chocolate, warm open sandwiches, soups, desserts.
christmas.thirdParagraph: For around an hour, participants embark on a storytelling walk that leads them into the world of Christmas, its values and its magic, all within the illuminated gardens. The walk ends at the Wesserling Farm, decorated with warm Christmas displays, around a hot drink or a convivial meal.
